彩叶从发光电线杆中遇见迅速长大的辉夜。两人在现实共同生活，也在月读组成由彩叶写歌: Iroha discovers Kaguya at a glowing utility pole and watches her grow rapidly. They live together in the real world and become creative partners in Tsukuyomi: Iroha writes the songs and Kaguya performs.

辉夜终究被月之使者带走。彩叶没有再次放弃音乐，而是完成《Reply》，让未能当面: The lunar envoys take Kaguya away. Iroha refuses to abandon music again and completes “Reply”, sending the words she could not say in person across the distance.
辉夜返航时落到约 8000 年前。漫长岁月后，她以月见八千代的虚拟形象建立月读、: On her return journey, Kaguya lands roughly 8,000 years in the past. After the long wait, she creates Tsukuyomi as Yachiyo Tsukimi’s virtual persona and waits for Iroha. Yachiyo is Kaguya after her journey through time.
彩叶选择学习相关技术，并在约十年后为辉夜／八千代打造能够感受现实的身体。实体辉夜: Iroha studies the technology needed to give Kaguya/Yachiyo a body that can experience the real world. About ten years later, physical Kaguya, virtual Yachiyo and Iroha share the stage for a happy ending across time.
稍近未来的网络虚拟空间。用户可以制作分身，在其中创作、直播、游戏和社交；它既是舞: A virtual space on the internet in the near future. Users create avatars to make art, stream, play and socialize. It is both a stage and a meeting point for real identities and virtual personas.
以获得和月见八千代同台机会为目标的竞赛。辉夜与彩叶借此走到大众视野中央。: A competition offering a chance to share the stage with Yachiyo Tsukimi. It brings Kaguya and Iroha into the public eye.
月读中的对战游戏。本页考察认为，公开合作赛可被视作对《竹取物语》“难题”的直播时: A competitive game in Tsukuyomi. This Wiki interprets its public collaboration match as a streaming-era echo of the impossible tasks in The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter; this is analysis, not official setting text.

辉夜是从月球来到地球的少女。她搭乘的飞船意外落在酒寄彩叶居所附近，最初以婴儿形态: Kaguya is a girl from the moon. Her spacecraft accidentally lands near Iroha Sakayori’s home. She first appears as a baby, then grows rapidly within days. Iroha names her Kaguya after The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, beginning their life together.
她不喜欢月球上重复而乏味的生活，把地球视为寻找乐趣和自由的新舞台。接触电脑后，她: She dislikes the repetitive, dull life on the moon and sees Earth as a new stage for fun and freedom. After discovering computers, she learns languages, internet culture and modern life with astonishing speed, and soon becomes interested in Tsukuyomi.
辉夜在现实中保留金色长发和宽松黑色上衣的轻快形象；进入月读后，则使用带兔耳、和服: In the real world, Kaguya has long blonde hair and a loose black shirt. In Tsukuyomi, her avatar combines rabbit ears, a kimono-like silhouette and crescent decorations. Use the image selector above to switch between the two forms.
辉夜开朗、调皮、爱撒娇，而且几乎没有面对陌生环境的拘谨感。她想到什么便立刻尝试，: Cheerful, mischievous and affectionate, Kaguya shows little hesitation in unfamiliar surroundings. She tries ideas immediately and often acts before considering the consequences. Her impulsiveness causes trouble but also helps her overcome obstacles.
月人的身体让她拥有远超常人的成长速度和适应能力。她能够改变发色、肤色等外观特征，: Her lunar body gives her extraordinary growth and adaptability. She can change her hair and skin color and has exceptional athletic abilities. Combined with accelerated learning, these traits let her quickly master devices, internet culture and streaming.
她喜欢甜食、零食和热闹的活动，同时有出色的料理天赋。初次认真下厨便做出令彩叶印象: She loves sweets, snacks and lively activities, and is a gifted cook. Her first serious attempt impresses Iroha, but she has little understanding of money: expensive ingredients and streaming equipment often catch the cash-strapped Iroha off guard.
彩叶起初只是无法放任来历不明的孩子，随后逐渐承担起监护人与家人的角色。辉夜从彩叶: At first, Iroha simply cannot abandon a mysterious child; she gradually becomes Kaguya’s guardian and family. Iroha’s humming gives Kaguya her first sense of security. Kaguya’s unreserved need and trust also give Iroha, for the first time, a home she can share with someone.
辉夜发现彩叶隐藏起来的音乐才能后，主动邀请她成为搭档。彩叶以“彩P”的身份负责作: After discovering Iroha’s hidden musical talent, Kaguya asks her to become her partner. As Iro-P, Iroha handles composition, arrangement, equipment and management, while Kaguya sings, streams and performs on camera. Together they become Kaguya × Iro-P.
两人的关系贯穿照顾、创作和相互拯救。辉夜把彩叶带回音乐之中，彩叶则不断拒绝接受命: Their relationship is built on care, creativity and helping one another. Kaguya brings Iroha back to music; Iroha refuses to accept their destined separation. Their happy ending is a future they must create, rather than an ending they can simply await.
组合活动与八千代杯: The duo and the Yachiyo Cup
辉夜第一次进入月读便遇见管理员兼顶级主播月见八千代，并观看了她的演唱会。八千代宣: On her first visit to Tsukuyomi, Kaguya meets its administrator and leading streamer, Yachiyo Tsukimi, and watches her concert. When Yachiyo announces the Yachiyo Cup, Kaguya immediately enters the follower-growth competition for a chance to sing with her idol.
她最初的直播缺乏规划，甚至在出道视频中暴露现实身份；彩叶加入后，两人把即兴企划、: Her first streams are unplanned, and her debut video even reveals her real identity. Once Iroha joins, spontaneous ideas, music and careful management help their audience grow. Kaguya also asks Roka and Mami for streaming advice, turning their private everyday life into a full stage career.
面对顶流组合“黑玛瑙”，辉夜和彩叶接受《合战》3V3挑战。虽然比赛由黑玛瑙获胜，: Kaguya and Iroha accept a three-on-three KASSEN challenge against the star team Black onyX. Black onyX wins the match, but the popularity Kaguya × Iro-P gains during the event narrowly wins them the Yachiyo Cup and a joint concert with Yachiyo.
松饼是辉夜和彩叶共同生活的重要记忆。彩叶最初用面粉和水做出的简陋食物并不好吃，却: Pancakes are an important memory of their life together. Iroha’s first simple flour-and-water pancakes do not taste good, yet Kaguya remembers that flavor throughout the long years. They represent the moment the two first became a family, rather than the food itself.
旧居漱口杯中牙刷数量的变化记录了辉夜进入彩叶生活的过程：从一支变成两支，意味着两: The toothbrushes in the cup at their old home trace Kaguya’s arrival in Iroha’s life. One becomes two as their belongings and routines overlap. In Yachiyo’s recreated memory room, there is only one again, suggesting her longing for a past she is afraid to approach.
彩叶的黑色旧 T 恤也贯穿辉夜的不同成长阶段。同一件衣服在不同年龄外观以及八千代: Iroha’s old black T-shirt also follows Kaguya through different stages of growth. The same shirt looks different on her changing body and on Yachiyo, linking infant dependence, teenage closeness and memories eight thousand years later.
《Reply》由彩叶为辉夜创作，其旋律与八千代的《Remember》彼此呼应。两: Iroha writes “Reply” for Kaguya, and its melody echoes Yachiyo’s “Remember”. The songs carry response and memory respectively, making singing a way to communicate across the moon, the real world and time.
辉夜的故事重新解释了《竹取物语》的离别结局：她知道自己可能被月人带走，却始终相信: Kaguya’s story reimagines the farewell in The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter. She knows the lunar envoys may take her away but believes the ending can be rewritten. Her actions, streams and songs share one wish: to bring everyone she cares about toward happiness rather than treat loss as the end.
辉夜与彩叶赢得八千代杯后搬入新居，并迎来与八千代的联动演唱会。演出期间出现月人发: After winning the Yachiyo Cup, Kaguya and Iroha move into a new home and perform with Yachiyo. An unusual signal from the lunar envoys interrupts the concert. Kaguya then tells Iroha that she is a runaway lunar princess and must return on the full moon of September 12, 2030.
辉夜发布隐退声明，并把毕业演唱会作为告别舞台。彩叶联合八千代、黑玛瑙、芦花和真实: Kaguya announces her retirement and a farewell concert. Iroha joins Yachiyo, Black onyX, Roka and Mami in trying to stop the lunar envoys, but they cannot keep her. After saying goodbye, the real-world Kaguya disappears, while her Tsukuyomi avatar rises toward the moon like the princess in the old tale.
彩叶拒绝把离别包装成一个勉强的好结局，完成新歌并借辉夜留下的手环向月球传递歌声。: Iroha refuses to present their separation as a forced happy ending. She completes a new song and sends it to the moon through Kaguya’s bracelet. Realizing that “Reply” and “Remember” share a melody, she recognizes a direct connection between Kaguya and the missing Yachiyo.
返回月球后的辉夜为了再次见到彩叶，制造了能够穿越时间的飞船，却因事故落入约八千年: Back on the moon, Kaguya builds a time-traveling spacecraft to see Iroha again, but an accident strands her on Earth roughly eight thousand years earlier. She relies on FUSHI to communicate, waits for the internet to emerge and eventually uses lunar technology to create Tsukuyomi, watching over Iroha as Yachiyo Tsukimi.
八千代认为经历八千年后的自己已经不能再作为昔日的辉夜面对彩叶，甚至想删除对方的悲: After eight thousand years, Yachiyo believes she can no longer face Iroha as the Kaguya she knew and even considers erasing Iroha’s sad memories. Through FUSHI, Iroha receives memories of the joy, war, loneliness and waiting that turned Kaguya into Yachiyo. She makes clear that she still wants to be with her.
由于八千代在月读中无法感受体温和味觉，彩叶转向相关科学领域，用十年时间推进感知系: Because Yachiyo cannot feel warmth or taste in Tsukuyomi, Iroha studies the relevant sciences and spends ten years developing sensory systems and a synthetic body. A body with familiar blonde hair and features finally awakens, giving Kaguya/Yachiyo a way back into real life and completing the happy ending.
把过载的生活重新写成音乐，并负责让舞台真正运转的人。: The person who turns an overloaded life back into music and keeps the stage running.
酒寄彩叶是故事的现实侧主人公。她独自在东京承担学业、打工和生活支出，表面可靠到近: Iroha Sakayori is the story’s real-world protagonist. Living alone in Tokyo, she balances school, part-time work and living expenses. She appears dependable and almost capable of anything, but has been pushing herself far beyond her limits.
她曾经写歌，却因家庭与生活压力把音乐搁置。辉夜的出现打破了她精密而封闭的日程，也: She once wrote songs but put music aside under pressure from family and everyday life. Kaguya disrupts her tightly scheduled, closed-off routine and makes creating again a choice she can no longer avoid.
彩叶兼具作曲、演奏、游戏与运营能力。在“辉夜×彩P”组合中，她不仅写歌，也负责直: Iroha combines composition, performance, gaming and management skills. In Kaguya × Iro-P, she writes music and handles stream planning, resources and crises.
月读中的虚拟形象强调狐耳、和风与制作人属性，和现实中的学生形象形成对照。: Her Tsukuyomi avatar emphasizes fox ears, Japanese-inspired styling and her producer role, contrasting with her real-world student appearance.
辉夜是彩叶重新拥抱音乐的契机，也是她第一次主动争取的未来。八千代起初是她仰慕的主: Kaguya gives Iroha a reason to embrace music again and a future she chooses to pursue. Yachiyo begins as a streamer she admires and later becomes the key to understanding the time loop.
辉夜离开后，彩叶没有接受“就此结束”的结局，而是完成《Reply》并继续追查八千: After Kaguya leaves, Iroha refuses to accept that the story is over. She finishes “Reply” and continues searching for Yachiyo.
理解八千代经历的漫长时间后，她转向相关科学领域，希望赋予对方能够感受现实的身体。: After understanding Yachiyo’s long wait, she turns to science to give her a body capable of experiencing reality. The results ten years later form the film’s happy ending.
月读的管理员、顶级主播，以及一场跨越八千年的等待。: Tsukuyomi’s administrator, a leading streamer and a wait spanning eight thousand years.
月见八千代与月读几乎同时进入公众视野。她能歌善舞，也能以分身承担管理员、新手引导: Yachiyo Tsukimi becomes publicly known around the same time as Tsukuyomi. She sings and dances, and her duplicates handle administration, tutorials and navigation. She is presented as a mysterious 8,000-year-old AI.
她真心享受创作者在月读中分享快乐的状态，并把维持这个空间视为自己的责任。: She sincerely enjoys seeing creators share happiness in Tsukuyomi and regards maintaining the space as her responsibility.
八千代既是偶像，也是平台本身的象征。她举办八千代杯、参与联动演出，并在辉夜和彩叶: Yachiyo is both an idol and a symbol of the platform itself. She runs the Yachiyo Cup, joins collaborative performances and watches Kaguya and Iroha’s growth from a shifting distance.
《Remember》代表等待与记忆；当《Reply》出现后，两首歌共同承担了跨越: “Remember” carries waiting and memory; with the arrival of “Reply”, the two songs become a narrative link across time.
彩叶是八千代的重要观众，辉夜则让两人的关系从单向仰慕变成复杂的时间回环。无剧透阅: Iroha is an important viewer to Yachiyo. Kaguya turns that one-sided admiration into a complex time loop. Without spoilers, the three can be understood as singer, producer and guardian of the platform.
八千代实际上是经历漫长时间后的辉夜。返航后的辉夜试图回到彩叶身边，却误入约八千年: Yachiyo is Kaguya after a long passage of time. Trying to return to Iroha after reaching the moon, she accidentally travels roughly eight thousand years into the past and gradually establishes Tsukuyomi through a new body and the internet.
她长期以“八千代”身份守望彩叶，既来自责任，也来自对自己已经不再是昔日辉夜的自卑: Her watch over Iroha as Yachiyo comes both from responsibility and from her fear that she is no longer the Kaguya Iroha knew. Iroha’s choice finally breaks that self-rejection.
把竞技对局变成大型表演的 Black onyX 领队。: Black onyX’s leader, who turns competitive matches into major performances.
帝アキラ是 Black onyX 的领队，公开形象张扬、擅长制造话题，也懂得如何: Akira Mikado leads Black onyX. His public persona is flamboyant and attention-grabbing, and he knows how to make a match into a livestream event that draws viewers in.
他向辉夜与彩叶发起 KASSEN 合作赛／挑战，使八千代杯从单纯涨粉竞赛转入正面: He challenges Kaguya and Iroha to a KASSEN collaboration match, turning the Yachiyo Cup from a follower-growth contest into a direct confrontation.
雷与乃依是其固定队友。三人的风格共同构成 Black onyX 的完整舞台形象。: Rai and Noi are his regular teammates. Their contrasting styles combine to form Black onyX’s stage identity.
帝アキラ与彩叶的现实关系属于剧情揭示。本页只在剧透区说明：他实际一直关注彩叶的处: Akira’s real-world relationship with Iroha is a plot reveal. In the spoiler section, the page explains that he has been watching over her circumstances and that his challenge also creates exposure for the duo.
Black onyX 中冷静寡言、兼具竞技与演唱能力的成员。: Black onyX’s calm, quiet member, skilled in both competition and singing.
驹泽雷话不多，常以冷静表现平衡团队的张扬气氛。除竞技实力外，他也具备出色的演唱能: Rai Komazawa says little, balancing the team’s flamboyance with a calm presence. Alongside his gaming skills, he is also a talented singer.
在 Black onyX 的三人配置中，雷负责提供稳定感，并与乃依形成鲜明的兄弟: Rai provides stability within the trio and forms a distinctive pair of brothers with Noi.
认真回应粉丝、偏爱可爱装扮的 Black onyX 成员。: A Black onyX member who responds warmly to fans and loves cute outfits.

在 KASSEN 与八千代杯等活动中，照琴让比赛结果更易被观众理解，也强化了直播: At KASSEN and Yachiyo Cup events, Terukoto helps viewers understand the outcome and reinforces the feeling of a live sporting event.

月读是作品近未来社会中的大型网络虚拟空间。用户以自定义分身进入，在其中直播、游戏: Tsukuyomi is a large online virtual space in the film’s near-future society. Users enter through custom avatars to stream, play, shop, socialize and create.
它既是演唱会舞台和竞技场，也是新闻、导航、货币和日常服务并存的平台。八千代的分身: It is a concert stage and arena, as well as a platform for news, navigation, currency and everyday services. Yachiyo’s duplicates do much of the administration and guidance.
月读把“现实中无法相见”改写为“仍能共享舞台”。角色在其中选择身份、建立关系，也: Tsukuyomi turns the inability to meet in reality into the possibility of sharing a stage. Characters choose identities, build relationships and encounter experiences their real bodies cannot provide.

作品并不只把对局处理为胜负，而是强调挑战书、组队、临场替补、解说和观众反应。: The film treats the match as more than a result, emphasizing the challenge, team formation, last-minute substitutes, commentary and audience reactions.

竹中诞生、快速成长、难题、回月: Birth from bamboo, rapid growth, impossible tasks and return to the moon
动画保留了辉夜姬突然出现、快速成长、引发关注并最终被月亮召回的基本骨架。: The film keeps the broad structure: Princess Kaguya suddenly appears, grows rapidly, attracts attention and is eventually recalled by the moon.
竹子被虹光电线杆替代，求婚难题转化为直播与竞技挑战，羽衣与月之迎接则进入现实和虚: A rainbow utility pole replaces bamboo; streaming and gaming challenges replace the impossible marriage tasks. The feather robe and lunar procession play out across real and virtual stages.
作品并非逐项机械改编原典。本页只记录明显结构呼应，并把进一步对应标为考察。: The film does not mechanically adapt every detail of the original. This Wiki records clear structural echoes and marks further parallels as interpretation.
